# Glottolog 5.3 (CLDF)

`languages.csv`, `values.csv`, `parameters.csv` and `codes.csv` from the CLDF release of Glottolog 5.3:

    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/glottolog/glottolog-cldf/v5.3/cldf/<file>

Hammarström, H., Forkel, R., Haspelmath, M. & Bank, S. Glottolog 5.3 (Max Planck Institute for
Evolutionary Anthropology, Leipzig, 2026). Licence: CC BY 4.0. SHA-256 sums in `SHA256SUMS`.
Used by `scripts/02a_glottolog_crosswalk.py` (lineages, classification paths, agglomerated
endangerment status, point coordinates).
